name: MONOTONE
description: Trixter's music tracker for the PC speaker, version 0.3.9, an alpha
author: Trixter of Hornet

start.note: DosKit picks the generic color display, the PC speaker and four tracks in its setup, then goes past its title screen. Ctrl+L loads a song, Ctrl+P plays it, F2 shows the pattern editor.

hint: MONOTONE asks three questions as it starts: press 1 for the generic color display, 0 for the PC speaker, 4 and Enter for four tracks, then any key at its title screen. Ctrl+L loads a song, such as PRELUDE.MON, and Ctrl+P plays it.
